summary: Verified GA4 tag G-YD0QS46B8 runtime behavior on production https://socialadda.org and https://www.socialadda.org. All 6 assertions from the review request PASSED. Tag is firing correctly; the 'no data received' status in GA4 admin is NOT a code bug and is attributable to (a) GA4 Data Stream URL mismatch (configured as https://www.socialadda.org but effective page_location is https://socialadda.org after 308 redirect) and/or (b) standard GA4 processing/reporting latency (up to 24-48h for a new/idle property).

www_redirect_308.detail: curl HEAD https://www.socialadda.org -> HTTP/2 308, location: https://socialadda.org/. Playwright navigation to www.socialadda.org resolved final URL to https://socialadda.org/.

gtag_js_loads_with_correct_id.detail: GET https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=G-YD0QS46B8 -> 200. Script tag present in DOM.

collect_request_fires_204.detail: Observed 2 POST requests to https://www.google-analytics.com/g/collect with tid=G-YD0QS46B8 (events: page_view and user_engagement). Response 204 No Content confirmed.

window_gtag_exists.detail: typeof window.gtag === 'function' evaluated true in browser context.

dataLayer_has_config_entry.detail: window.dataLayer contains entry ['config','G-YD0QS46B8'] (plus 'js', gtm.dom, gtm.load). dataLayer length = 4.

page_location_dl_param.status: PASS (matches actual runtime URL, MISMATCH with GA4 Stream config)
page_location_dl_param.detail: dl param in /g/collect = https://socialadda.org/ (non-www). This is the true page_location after the 308. The GA4 Data Stream is configured for https://www.socialadda.org — this is the likely root cause of the 'Data collection isn't active' banner in GA4 admin.

root_cause_analysis.issue_reported: GA4 Tag Assistant: 'Google tag G-YD0QS46B8 not found'; GA4 Data Stream: 'Data collection isn't active'.
root_cause_analysis.actual_runtime_state: GA4 tag IS installed, IS loading (gtag.js 200), IS firing page_view+user_engagement to /g/collect with correct tid=G-YD0QS46B8 receiving 204 responses. window.gtag is a function, dataLayer contains config entry. Everything on the client side is correct.
root_cause_analysis.why_tag_assistant_reports_not_found: Google Tag Assistant frequently reports 'not found' when accessed via a URL that redirects (www -> apex). Tag Assistant loads the URL the user entered and may not follow cross-host 308 redirects reliably when scanning for tags — resulting in a false 'not found' for www.socialadda.org. When Tag Assistant is pointed at https://socialadda.org (the post-redirect canonical URL), the tag will be detected.
root_cause_analysis.why_data_stream_shows_inactive: Two contributing factors: (1) GA4 Data Stream URL is configured as https://www.socialadda.org, but the actual page_location (dl param) being reported is https://socialadda.org/ due to the 308 redirect. GA4 still ingests hits (tid match is what routes data), but the admin 'Data collection isn't active' banner is time-based and only clears after data has been received & processed — up to 24-48h for new/low-traffic properties. (2) Reporting latency: GA4 Realtime typically shows hits within seconds, but the Data Stream health indicator uses processed data (delayed).
recommended_mitigation: Update the GA4 Data Stream URL in GA4 admin from https://www.socialadda.org to https://socialadda.org to match the canonical (post-redirect) hostname. This is a config change in GA4, NOT a code change.
Alternatively, invert the redirect (apex -> www) if the brand prefers www as canonical — but the code fix is unnecessary; current setup is working.
Verify in GA4 > Reports > Realtime that events appear (they should within ~30s of a live visit).
Wait 24-48h for the Data Stream health banner to update; it typically self-clears once processed events accumulate.
In Tag Assistant, test against https://socialadda.org (not www) to get an accurate detection.

action_items: NO CODE CHANGES REQUIRED. The GA4 tag is installed and firing correctly.
Non-code action for site owner: Update GA4 Data Stream URL to https://socialadda.org (apex) OR flip redirect direction to apex->www. Then wait ~24h.
critical_code_review_comments: GA4 gtag snippet in /app/frontend/public/index.html is correctly implemented (script src + inline config with G-YD0QS46B8). No changes needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GA4 tag on socialadda.org is confirmed working via network capture. tid=G-YD0QS46B8, /g/collect returns 204, dl=https://socialadda.org/. The GA4 admin 'not active' status is due to Stream URL mismatch (www vs apex) and processing delay, not a code issue. www.socialadda.org 308-redirects to socialadda.org — confirmed via both curl and Playwright.
